# CorpTimer

> Free browser-based timers for meetings, focus, classrooms, workouts and everyday activities.

## Public timer pages

- [Meeting Timer](https://corptimer.com/): Online meeting agenda timer with speaker slots, time carryover, templates and a live audience view.
- [Boxing Timer](https://corptimer.com/boxing-timer/): Online boxing round timer with rest periods, a gong, individual round lengths and adjustable warning cues.
- [Fitness Timer](https://corptimer.com/fitness-timer/): Online interval timer for HIIT, Tabata, EMOM, AMRAP and custom workouts with repeated sets and recovery.
- [Pomodoro Timer](https://corptimer.com/pomodoro-timer/): Online Pomodoro timer with editable focus sessions, short and long breaks, sound cues and manual or automatic handoff.
- [Classroom Timer](https://corptimer.com/classroom-timer/): Online classroom activity timer for lessons, group work and quiet reading, with optional visual-only progress.
- [Chess Timer](https://corptimer.com/chess-timer/): Online two-player chess clock with editable time controls, increment, delay and turn handoff.
- [Online Stopwatch](https://corptimer.com/stopwatch/): Online stopwatch with elapsed time, lap splits, pause and resume, and CSV results export.
- [Simple Timer](https://corptimer.com/simple-timer/): Online countdown timer with a custom duration, adjustable alarm, fullscreen display and one-minute extensions.
- [New Year Countdown](https://corptimer.com/new-year-countdown/): New Year countdown to January 1 at midnight in your chosen time zone, with an optional alarm and fullscreen display.
- [5 Minute Timer](https://corptimer.com/5-minute-timer/): Start a 5 minute timer with one click. Pause, reset, add time or use a fullscreen countdown with an adjustable alarm.
- [10 Minute Timer](https://corptimer.com/10-minute-timer/): Start a 10 minute timer with one click. Pause, reset, add time or use a fullscreen countdown with an adjustable alarm.
- [15 Minute Timer](https://corptimer.com/15-minute-timer/): Start a 15 minute timer with one click. Pause, reset, add time or use a fullscreen countdown with an adjustable alarm.
- [20 Minute Timer](https://corptimer.com/20-minute-timer/): Start a 20 minute timer with one click. Pause, reset, add time or use a fullscreen countdown with an adjustable alarm.
- [25 Minute Timer](https://corptimer.com/25-minute-timer/): Start a 25 minute timer with one click. Pause, reset, add time or use a fullscreen countdown with an adjustable alarm.
- [30 Minute Timer](https://corptimer.com/30-minute-timer/): Start a 30 minute timer with one click. Pause, reset, add time or use a fullscreen countdown with an adjustable alarm.
- [Kitchen Timer](https://corptimer.com/kitchen-timer/): Cook several dishes independently, with named steps and separate alarms.
- [Meditation Timer](https://corptimer.com/meditation-timer/): A quiet meditation timer with preparation, interval bells and a gentle finish.
- [Tea Brewing Timer](https://corptimer.com/tea-brewing-timer/): Time repeated tea infusions with editable brewing stages and temperature notes.
- [Toothbrushing Timer](https://corptimer.com/toothbrushing-timer/): Follow a visible brushing-zone sequence with gentle handoff cues.
- [Breathing Timer](https://corptimer.com/breathing-timer/): Follow an editable breathing rhythm with a gently expanding and contracting visual.
- [Yoga Timer](https://corptimer.com/yoga-stretching-timer/): Name your poses, time each hold and see which side or movement comes next.
- [Speech Timer](https://corptimer.com/speech-timer/): Rehearse a speech with editable green, amber and red timing signals.
- [Egg Timer](https://corptimer.com/egg-timer/): Follow egg doneness milestones from runny to hard-boiled with a visible yolk guide.
- [Multi Stopwatch](https://corptimer.com/multi-stopwatch/): Time six people independently, with individual starts, laps and finishes.
- [Running Coach Timer](https://corptimer.com/running-coach-timer/): Manage independent running efforts and recovery for a group.
- [Swimming Timer](https://corptimer.com/swimming-timer/): Record elapsed times and lap splits across six swimming lanes.
- [Circuit Training Timer](https://corptimer.com/circuit-training-timer/): Run separate work and recovery clocks for training stations.
- [Climbing Timer](https://corptimer.com/climbing-timer/): Keep climbing attempts and rest periods visible for several climbers.
- [Sailing Start Timer](https://corptimer.com/sailing-start-timer/): Practice a regatta start with an editable visual countdown.
- [Archery Timer](https://corptimer.com/archery-timer/): Show preparation, shooting and changeover periods for archery practice.
- [Sports Timekeeper](https://corptimer.com/sports-scoreboard-timer/): Keep game, attack, timeout and penalty countdowns on one board.
- [Multiplayer Board Game Timer](https://corptimer.com/board-game-timer/): Give up to six players their own time bank and pass the turn.
- [Debate Timer](https://corptimer.com/debate-timer/): Run editable speech sequences for two sides of a practice debate.
- [Exam Station Timer](https://corptimer.com/exam-station-timer/): Track task and transition time for parallel exam stations.
- [Speed Networking Timer](https://corptimer.com/speed-networking-timer/): Keep networking conversations and partner changeovers on schedule.
- [Darkroom Timer](https://corptimer.com/darkroom-timer/): Follow separate development sequences for photographic batches.
- [Coffee Brewing Timer](https://corptimer.com/coffee-brewing-timer/): Follow an editable bloom, pour and draw-down sequence for coffee.
- [Bakery Batch Timer](https://corptimer.com/bakery-timer/): Track independent bakery batches through mixing, resting, proofing and baking.
- [Laboratory Sample Timer](https://corptimer.com/laboratory-timer/): Run independent sample countdowns with named processing stages.
- [Workshop Job Timer](https://corptimer.com/workshop-job-timer/): Measure active work separately for several jobs or clients.
- [Escape Room Timer](https://corptimer.com/escape-room-timer/): Run independent room countdowns and adjust time during a game.
- [Skydiving Ground Preparation Timer](https://corptimer.com/skydiving-ground-timer/): Coordinate briefing and ground preparation for several skydiving groups.

## Directory and usage

- [Other Timers](https://corptimer.com/timers/): Browse all activities and preset countdowns.
- Each timer page contains a public, expandable How it works and advice guide in its HTML.
- JavaScript is required to operate the clocks; an account is not required.
- Timer settings, custom timers, templates and favorites save locally, with optional Google account synchronization.
- Keep the tab open for alarms; background and mobile delivery depend on the browser.
- Live audience links are temporary session views, not indexable timer guides.
